{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7227905429513322548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"已上諸經，其皆大同小異，亦皆自言祕妙，互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"推短長，若不遍求，即用之不足。近來學者，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"攻五姓八宅、黄道白方，例皆違犯大經，未免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"灾咎。所以人犯修動，致令造者不居，却毁陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"陽而無據效，豈不痛哉。况先賢垂籍，誡勗昭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"彰，人自㝠蒙，日用而不識其象者。日月乾坤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"寒暑雄雌，晝夜陰陽等，所以包羅萬象，舉一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"千從，運變無形，而能化物大矣哉。陰陽之理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"也，經之陰者生化物，情之母也；陽者生化物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"情之父也。作天地之祖，爲孕育之尊，順之則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7227901927106035769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"亨，逆之則否何異。公忠受爵，違命變殃者乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"今採諸祕驗，分爲二十四路，八卦九宫，配女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content" {"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"乾將三男震、坎、艮，悉屬於陽位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"即從西北乾位之震爲陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"坤將三女巽、離、兊悉屬陰之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"即從東南巽角順之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"戌爲陰明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽不獨王，以陰爲得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"陽宅爲宜修陰方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7227905417899409411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"陰不獨王，以陽爲得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":52,"lineType":2,"content":"如上說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如冬以温暖爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"德，夏以凉。冷爲德，男以女爲德，女以男爲德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"之義。易訣云：陰得陽如暑得凉，五姓咸和百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"事俱昌。所以德位高壯藹密即吉，重陰重陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"則凶。陽宅更招東方、北
